notes: Read SKILL.md (340 lines) in full. The skill guides building production-quality frontend UI: component structure and composition, state-management choices, design-system adherence and avoiding the generic 'AI aesthetic', WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility (keyboard, ARIA, focus), responsive layout, loading/empty/error states, and a verification checklist.

Following it, the agent writes UI components in the user's project; the React/Tailwind/CSS snippets are illustrations. No shell commands, installs, credentials, or network access are instructed (the 'search a trusted reference catalogue' step at SKILL.md:122 is optional design research and warns against copying other products' branding or text).

SKILL.md:308 has an optional 'See Also' pointer to ../../references/accessibility-checklist.md, which is outside the skill directory and will not ship; the core accessibility guidance is already inline, so the skill works without it.
